headline: Senegal: Groupe EDK closes its 30 billion FCFA bond issue ahead of schedule
summary: The EDK Group announced on November 25, 2026, the early closing of its 30 billion FCFA bond issue, five days before its scheduled deadline. The group is led by Demba Ka.
why: Bond issues let private companies raise debt from investors, and strong subscription signals appetite for corporate paper in regional markets.
original_headline: Sénégal : le Groupe EDK boucle par anticipation son emprunt obligataire de 30 milliards de FCFA
